capabilities: Display a card-based dashboard with configurable navigation targets
Customize banner title, subtitle, typography, colors, and alignment
Select, position, and crop a banner image
Add calendar, analog/digital clock, and Pomodoro timer widgets
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual (copying files into the plugins folder).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in start page or dashboard view, so users must assemble one from notes and embeds.
summary: Card-based dashboard that shows a customizable banner with navigation links plus calendar, clock, and Pomodoro widgets.
